name: Gaffer Jack
summary: Off Auberdine, Gaffer Jack parts lie beneath Darkshore's waves. Wizbang Cranktoggle lost a crate of them during his voyage across the sea.

sections.title: Lost at Sea
sections.body: Gnome tinkerer Wizbang Cranktoggle booked passage to Auberdine, seeking quiet away from Ironforge's forge-works and taverns. During the voyage, he drank too much and fumbled an entire container of gaffer jacks over the railing. The small fasteners sank into Darkshore's coastal waters, leaving Wizbang without the parts he needed to tune his stintle pegs.

sections.title: Sunken Salvage
sections.body: The gaffer jacks sank in the surf along Darkshore's shore, where patient fishermen sometimes snag them on their hooks. Recovering the parts lets Wizbang assemble his strange contraptions. Finding tiny metal hardware in the open sea takes patience and luck.

faq.q: What is a Gaffer Jack used for?
aliases: what does a gaffer jack do
faq.answer: Wizbang Cranktoggle needs gaffer jacks to tune the stintle pegs in his experimental inventions.

faq.q: How did these end up in the ocean around Auberdine?
aliases: why are gaffer jacks in the water
faq.answer: Wizbang Cranktoggle sailed from the Eastern Kingdoms, seeking quiet away from Ironforge. He drank too much during the voyage and accidentally dropped his crate of gaffer jacks overboard into Darkshore's waters.
Wizbang Cranktoggle, an eccentric gnome inventor staying in Auberdine, wants eight gaffer jacks returned so he can keep building his strange inventions.

faq.q: Where can Gaffer Jacks be found?
faq.answer: Gaffer jacks lie submerged along Darkshore's coast. Anglers sometimes snag them while fishing the coastal surf.

angles.text: As an engineer, you know how frustrating it is to lose specialized hardware like gaffer jacks. Without them, delicate mechanisms such as stintle pegs cannot be calibrated.
As a gnome, you may find leaving Ironforge for a quiet life in Auberdine unorthodox. Losing a crate of essential parts over a ship's rail after drinking too much is another matter.
